::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}/deliveries/{del}/redeliver"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The webhook endpoint's id. |
| `del` | `string` | **yes** | Delivery id to redeliver |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The delivery's id. |
| `status` | `string` | The delivery's status. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | Number of delivery attempts so far. |
| `next_attempt_at` | `string` | When the next attempt is due (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `last_response_status` | `integer` | The HTTP status your endpoint last returned. |
| `attempt` | `object` | The ONE attempt this call just made. Live only — tmbilling stores none of it, so this response is the only place it exists; there is no endpoint to fetch it back from later. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The settled delivery plus the attempt just made |
| `404` | No such delivery, or the endpoint is in the other partition |
| `409` | A delivery for this event/endpoint is still pending |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints/whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/deliveries/whd_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/redeliver" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
